answer:
The most recent Republican to win a New York gubernatorial election was **George Pataki** (1994).  
When he first ran for Governor, Pataki appeared on the ballot under **three party lines**:

| Ballot line | Party name as written on the ballot |
|-------------|-------------------------------------|
| 1 | **Republican** |
| 2 | **Conservative** |
| 3 | **Tax Cut Now** |

These lines are shown on the official 1994 New York State Election results page, where Pataki’s entry lists “Republican / Conservative / Tax Cut Now” as the parties under which he was elected.
